questions.question: Which country's marathon runner, Ruti Aga, received a six-year suspension from the Athletics Integrity Unit for doping and fraud offences?
questions.explanation: Ethiopian athlete Ruti Aga received a lengthy ban after returning a positive drug test and providing fake paperwork to investigators.
questions.context: The Athletics Integrity Unit bans Ethiopian marathon runner Ruti Aga for six years after she tested positive for methylprednisolone and submitted false information and a forged prescription during an investigation.

questions.question: Which international judicial institution was awarded the 2026 Sakharov Prize by the European Parliament?
questions.explanation: The European Parliament recognised the International Criminal Court and its personnel with the Sakharov Prize for their commitment to global justice.
questions.context: The European Parliament awards its 2026 Sakharov Prize to the International Criminal Court and its officials for their work in global justice and upholding international law.

questions.question: The Onkalo repository, the first licensed deep geological disposal site for spent nuclear fuel, is located in which European country?
questions.explanation: The Finnish government approved an operating licence for Posiva's Onkalo repository in Eurajoki.
questions.context: The Finnish Government grants Posiva an operating license for the Onkalo spent nuclear fuel repository in Eurajoki, making it the world's first licensed deep geological disposal facility for spent nuclear fuel.

questions.question: Health authorities in which European nation identified the first human case of the livestock-associated Shamonda virus?
questions.explanation: The first human detection of the Shamonda virus was recorded in France in a patient who had passed away from an unrelated ailment.
questions.context: France reports the first human case of the livestock Shamonda virus in a patient who died after being hospitalized with an unrelated condition.

questions.question: Diplomat Lana Nusseibeh launched a bid to become Secretary-General of the United Nations on behalf of which country?
questions.explanation: Lana Nusseibeh, representing the UAE, formally entered the selection process for the UN Secretary-General position.
questions.context: 2026 United Nations Secretary-General selection: Emirati diplomat Lana Nusseibeh announces her candidacy for Secretary-General of the United Nations.
